reviewed_stories.title: Saudi supply restoration and diplomacy push Brent below $100
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration. OGDC, PPL and MARI sell produced hydrocarbons, so lower benchmark crude prices are directionally adverse to oil-linked realizations, with MARI less directly exposed than OGDC and PPL.
reviewed_stories.reason: Saudi Arabia restarted the East-West Pipeline after Tuesday's close, restoring an alternative route capable of carrying roughly 4 million barrels per day. By Wednesday morning Brent was below $100 as supply conditions improved and diplomacy hopes increased. This materially reverses the prior weak positive crude-price tailwind.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Article pages verified: Saudi pipeline restart September 22 at 04:27 PM PKT; Business Recorder oil update September 23 at 07:49 AM PKT; Mettis Asian markets update September 23 at 09:32 AM PKT. The Mettis page timestamp is used instead of the raw feed's incorrect +00:00 offset.

reviewed_stories.title: Petrol and HSD prices cut for September 23
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link: Oil Marketing, including PSO. The government reset changes ex-depot selling prices but the fresh evidence does not establish a change in OMC margin economics.
reviewed_stories.reason: Petrol was reduced by Rs1.70 per litre to Rs392.05 and HSD by Rs3.12 to Rs418.96. The article attributes the reset to the pricing mechanism and global Platts, premium and incidental changes, but provides no evidence of a changed OMC margin or quantified volume or inventory effect.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Mettis Global article page verified September 23, 2026 at 12:14 AM GMT+05:00.

reviewed_stories.title: ADB keeps Pakistan FY2027 growth forecast at 3.7pc and sees 8.3pc inflation
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Broad Pakistan macro backdrop only. The committed item does not establish a traceable direct or configured-sector cash-flow effect for a tracked PSX name.
reviewed_stories.reason: The committed headline and snippet describe growth below the government's 4pc budget target and inflation above its 7pc estimate, which is an unfavorable macro mix, but no company-specific or configured-sector transmission is established from the accessible evidence.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: The committed raw feed records September 23, 2026 at 09:20:55 AM PKT. The linked Dawn body was not accessible in this cloud session, so the timestamp and evidence remain headline/snippet-level rather than page-verified.

reviewed_stories.title: Macter International board recommends 5-for-1 share split
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Macter International Limited is PSX-listed as MACTER, but MACTER is not in the repository's current tracked universe shown in the committed raw file, so it has no direct or configured-sector linkage to this desk.
reviewed_stories.reason: The board recommended reducing face value from Rs10 to Rs2, giving five shares for each existing share, subject to approvals. Total paid-up capital is unchanged, so the split itself does not establish a change in enterprise economics; it is also outside the tracked universe.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Mettis Global article page verified September 23, 2026 at 09:38 AM GMT+05:00. The page timestamp is used instead of the raw feed's incorrect +00:00 offset.

reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Broad policy-administration headline only. It does not establish a direct or configured-sector cash-flow link for a tracked PSX name.
reviewed_stories.reason: The available headline describes a clarification about institutional responsibility for the IMF programme, not a verified change in programme terms, financing, review status or policy conditionality. With no accessible article body, no stronger economic inference is justified.
